cases.question: How do I change a flat bicycle tyre?
cases.draft: To change a flat bicycle tyre, first identify required tools like a spare tyre, pump, tyre levers, and wrench. Secure the bike on a flat surface, then remove the wheel with the flat tyre. Use tyre levers to remove the tyre, replace the inner tube if damaged, and reinstall the tyre ensuring it's correctly aligned. Finally, pump up the tyre to the recommended pressure and reattach the wheel to the bike.
